purpose: Portable native CUDA MuJoCo execution without host Python dependencies or Triton library modules; not historical binary parity or learned-performance evidence.

protocol.build: CPU allocation; CUDA wheel dependency resolution; native CPU image test; observed inventories and image hash.
protocol.gpu_validation: Separate allocated NVIDIA GPU: real CUDA kernel, preserved scheduler visibility, native adapter tests, four active DMS smokes, saved-source evaluation and unchanged checkpoint. Fixed-action physics comparison against the validated CPU image on the same node.
protocol.empty_visibility_check: Inside a separate run-cuda process with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, assert the variable stays empty and CUDA detects zero devices.

commands.name: empty-gpu-visibility
command: import os,torch; assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")==""; assert torch.cuda.device_count()==0; assert not torch.cuda.is_available()
